title: 2 - 3 days per week - Accounts Assistant - Basildon - &;32k Full time equiv.
description:
Assistant Finance Officer - Part-Time - Basildon

Salary up to £32,000 FTE Permanent

A well-established charity based in Basildon is looking to recruit an organised and hands-on Assistant Finance Officer to support its day-to-day financial operations.

This is a great opportunity to join a purpose-driven organisation providing valuable support to its local community, taking responsibility for a varied range of finance and bookkeeping duties while helping maintain strong financial controls and accurate reporting.

The role will initially be 2 days per week, with the opportunity to increase to 3 days per week as the organisation grows and the role develops. The salary is up to £32,000 per annum full-time equivalent (FTE), pro rata to the hours worked.

Working closely with the CEO and existing finance team, you'll help keep financial records accurate and up to date, manage invoicing and income, support reconciliations and prepare financial information for management and the Board of Trustees.

The Role
- Maintain accurate financial records using Xero.
- Prepare and issue invoices for Local Authority placements, private client fees and other income streams.
- Monitor outstanding invoices and payments, following up on queries sensitively and professionally.
- Reconcile bank accounts, charity shop income, cash, card receipts and Local Authority payments.
- Process approved payments and maintain accurate supplier and payment records.
- Monitor expenditure, reconcile bank card transactions and investigate discrepancies.
- Assist with grant and project budget monitoring, maintaining records of funded expenditure.
- Prepare monthly income and expenditure reports for the CEO.
- Support quarterly financial reporting for the Board of Trustees and Finance Sub-Committee.
- Maintain insurance and vehicle compliance records, monitoring renewal dates and requirements.
- Liaise with external accountants and support year-end accounts, audits and independent examinations.
- Help maintain effective financial procedures and controls.

About You
- At least three years' experience in a finance, accounts, bookkeeping or financial administration role.
- Experience preparing invoices, monitoring payments and maintaining accurate financial records.
- Confident with bank reconciliations, income and expenditure monitoring and investigating discrepancies.
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel and experience using accounting software; Xero experience would be beneficial.
- Strong organisational skills, numerical accuracy and attention to detail.
- Able to manage your workload independently and meet deadlines in a busy environment.
- Professional and discreet when handling confidential financial information.
- AAT qualified or studying would be advantageous.
- Previous experience in a charity, not-for-profit, health or social care setting would be beneficial.
- A kind, patient and approachable manner, with the ability to communicate sensitively with vulnerable individuals and their families.

What's on Offer?
- Permanent, part-time position.
- Initially 2 days per week, increasing to 3 days per week over time.
- Salary up to £32,000 FTE, pro rata to hours worked.
- A varied role covering bookkeeping, invoicing, reporting and financial administration.
- The opportunity to use your finance skills within a worthwhile organisation making a difference to the local community.

If you have a solid finance background and are looking for a part-time opportunity with the potential to grow your hours over time, please get in touch for a confidential discussion.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
An established and growing business is seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Finance Assistant to support the day-to-day activities of the finance function.

This is a varied position that combines finance, payroll coordination, cash management and month-end accounting responsibilities. Working closely with the wider finance team and an external payroll bureau, you will play a key role in ensuring accurate financial processing and supporting the production of management information.

The role would suit an experienced hands-on professional looking for a broad accounting position with genuine variety, responsibility and progression.
Key Responsibilities include:
- Maintain accurate cash book postings.
- Prepare and reconcile bank accounts.
- Support the management of daily cash transactions.
- Act as the main liaison with the external payroll bureau.
- Process starter, leaver and employee change information.
- Verify timesheets and variable pay data for payroll submission.
- Assist with work-in-progress calculations.
- Prepare monthly accruals and journals.
- Maintain and reconcile the prepayments schedule.
- Complete balance sheet reconciliations.
- Analyse profit and loss accounts and investigate variances.
- Produce ad hoc reports and financial analysis.

We're seeking a finance professional with experience in an accounting environment and exposure to payroll processes. You'll have strong attention to detail, excellent organisational skills and a proactive approach, alongside the confidence to communicate effectively with both internal and external stakeholders.

You will be highly proficient in Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP and data analysis, with the ability to work accurately with financial information and accounting systems. Experience of Sage 200 would be advantageous, although it is not essential.

This is an office-based position, 08:00 - 16:00, Monday to Friday, flexible alternative hours can be considered.

description:
This Purchase Ledger Clerk position in the property sector is all about keeping things organised and running smoothly. You'll be responsible for managing invoices, payments, and financial records, ensuring everything adds up and deadlines are met.

Client Details

This role is with a company in the property sector, based in Essex.

Description
- Process supplier invoices accurately and in a timely manner.
- Reconcile supplier statements and resolve any discrepancies.
- Prepare and process payment runs, ensuring all approvals are in place.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date purchase ledger records.
- Handle supplier queries and provide resolutions promptly.
- Assist with month-end tasks, including reporting and reconciliations.
- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth financial operations.
- Support the wider Accounting & Finance department as needed.

Profile

A successful Purchase Ledger Clerk should have:
- Experience in a similar role, preferably within the property sector or Accounting & Finance.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy in financial tasks.
- Good communication skills for liaising with suppliers and internal teams.
- Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
- An organised and methodical approach to work.
- A willingness to learn and adapt to new processes.

Job Offer
- A salary ranging up to £29,000 per year, dependent on the level of experience.
- A permanent position within the property sector.
- Opportunities to develop your skills in a supportive Accounting & Finance team.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: Sales Ledger Clerk
description:
Sales Ledger Clerk - Permanent, Full Time
up to 35k Per Annum (DOE)

Our client based in Basildon are seeking a Sales Ledger Clerk to join their team on a permanent basis. The successful candidate will be reporting directly to the Financial Controller, producing sales invoices and credit notes. Please note, this is a fully office based position.

Duties:
- Produce sales invoices and credit notes
- Dealing with our clients directly on a regular basis, accessing various portals for uploading invoices, as well as shipping, factory and other supporting documentation
- Understanding different methods of sales revenue (FOB, Landed, Online, DTC, Amazon etc.) as accounts are across multiple entities in multiple currencies.
- Maintaining the sales order reports
- Credit control of the allocated accounts
- Communicating with retailers, factories, and other external stakeholders
- Liaising with Directors and Sales Coordinators
- Resolving queries and disputes in a timely and professional manner
- Assisting the Financial Controller with ad-hoc duties as and when required

Candidate requirements:
- A minimum of 3 years' experience in a similar finance role is necessary
- Experience with Sage 50 software is essential and must have worked within Sales or Purchase Ledger previously
- Excellent organisation skills and the ability to prioritise tasks
- High attention to detail to ensure data is inputted accurately
- Team player
- Strong communication skills, both verbal and written
- Self-motivated and driven to complete all tasks in a timely and effective manner
- Competent in Excel

Benefits:
- Workplace pension
- Free on-site parking
- Annual bonus scheme
- Summertime working hours (1pm finish on Fridays)
- 20 days holiday, plus public holidays
- Financial support towards accounting qualification
- Casual dress code

Monday to Friday, 9am-5:30pm with an early finish on Fridays
Fully office based with free parking and a brilliant working environment

Huntress does not discriminate on the grounds of age, race, gender, disability, creed or sexual orientation and complies with all relevant UK legislation. PLEASE NOTE! You should make yourself aware of how immigration laws apply to your situation before applying for any jobs. We are acting as a Recruitment Business in relation to this role.

title: Sales ledger/Billing & Invoice Clerk
description:
Sales Ledger/Billing & Invoice Clerk - Hybrid (2 days in the office, 3 days WFH)
- Annual Salary: £27,000 - £31,000 per annum
- Location: Brentwood
- Job Type: Permanent, Full-time - Hybrid (2 days in office, 3 days WFH)

Reed Accountancy are recruiting in Brentwood for a Sales Ledger/Billing & Invoice Specialist. This role is crucial for managing the end-to-end billing cycle, ensuring all materials and subcontractor costs are captured accurately, billed correctly, and recovered in full. This position supports strong commercial performance by protecting margins and providing critical insights through analysis and reporting.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Manage the complete billing process, ensuring the production of accurate and timely client invoices.
- Provide daily support with client billing applications, ensuring correct submissions and updates to trackers.
- Proactively chase subcontractors for required documentation and invoices within agreed timeframes.
- Capture all out-of-scope and chargeable costs correctly on client systems.
- Review reactive applications for accuracy, compliance, categorisation, and correct mark-ups.
- Protect profit margins by ensuring correct application of mark-ups on reactive works.
- Support supplier reviews and recommend process improvements.
- Provide analysis and reporting on cost recovery ratios, highlighting risks and improvement opportunities.
- Resolve rejected or disputed works to enable resubmission for payment.
- Troubleshoot billing discrepancies and system issues, supporting ongoing system development.
- Act as a key liaison between Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Third Parties, and IT.
- Ensure billing processes comply with internal controls and agreed client requirements.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- GCSE Maths and English (or equivalent).
- Studying towards an accountancy qualification (desirable).
- Intermediate Excel skills.
- Experience working in a Sales Ledger or billing-focused finance role.
- Proven ability to work to tight deadlines with exceptional attention to detail.
- Confident working with Excel and accounting systems.
- Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to engage with clients and stakeholders.
- Comfortable working under pressure in a fast-paced, changing environment.

Benefits:
- Up to 4% discretionary bonus scheme, subject to achievement of targets.
- 25 days holiday plus Bank holidays.
- Group personal pension scheme with matched contributions between 5% and 6%.
- Health Cash Plan & Life assurance.
- Discounts, vouchers, and financial aid programs.
- Learning & Development opportunities.
- Funded Training Sponsorship Scheme.
- Cycle to Work Scheme.

If you are analytical, organised, and passionate about delivering high-quality financial processes, we would love to hear from you.
